rules.required_validation: Exact CUDA Torch abs on the source storage dtype, including signed minimum overflow, signed zero, NaN, infinities and bool byte normalization.

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.
configuration.grid_domain: Host cdiv grid uses exact nonnegative integers; signed-int grid-x parsing requires gridM*gridN<2^31, otherwise genuine gridParse/gridLimit first rejection before entry hook, CPU-pointer extraction, launch and exit hook. This is a target launch prerequisite, not an address-safety inference.
configuration.returned_semantics: NativeResult specifies independent actual-address write plan, returned tensors, every final byte, and untouched-byte frame. Mathematical transpose additionally follows under optional ArithmeticRefines; it is not a premise of the main outcome theorem.
configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
configuration.empty_rank_stride_partition: empty numel=0 dominates; else rank!=2; else both strides!=1; else rank2 valid_matrix with supported grid, or oversized_grid; no metadata extent omitted

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.
configuration.grid_domain: Host cdiv grid uses exact nonnegative integers; signed-int grid-x parsing requires gridM*gridN<2^31, otherwise genuine gridParse/gridLimit first rejection before entry hook, CPU-pointer extraction, launch and exit hook. This is a target launch prerequisite, not an address-safety inference.
configuration.returned_semantics: NativeResult specifies independent actual-address write plan, returned tensors, every final byte, and untouched-byte frame. Mathematical transpose additionally follows under optional ArithmeticRefines; it is not a premise of the main outcome theorem.

Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.
configuration.grid_domain: Host cdiv grid uses exact nonnegative integers; signed-int grid-x parsing requires gridM*gridN<2^31, otherwise genuine gridParse/gridLimit first rejection before entry hook, CPU-pointer extraction, launch and exit hook. configuration.metadata_specialization: Each actual nonnegative M/N/stride argument below 2^63 specializes independently: value1 is constexpr; other values below2^31 are signed_i32; remaining values are signed_i64. Output strides are coupled to [N,M]: stride_bm=1, stride_bn=M.
configuration.integer_expression_semantics: pid and lane ranges are i32; every expression node promotes constants to the other operand width, i32+i32 stays i32, otherwise i64. Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.
configuration.grid_domain: Host cdiv grid uses exact nonnegative integers; signed-int grid-x parsing requires gridM*gridN<2^31, otherwise genuine gridParse/gridLimit first rejection before entry hook, CPU-pointer extraction, launch and exit hook. This is a target launch prerequisite, not an address-safety inference.
configuration.returned_semantics: NativeResult specifies independent actual-address write plan, returned tensors, every final byte, and untouched-byte frame. Mathematical transpose additionally follows under optional ArithmeticRefines; it is not a premise of the main outcome theorem.
configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver

No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.

Each i32/i64 arithmetic node wraps before later promotion. Constant arithmetic is unbounded; all-constant division/modulo use Python floor semantics, while runtime signed division truncates toward zero and remainder follows it. Division by zero or signed_min/-1 is an integerDivision observation.
configuration.address_domain: Actual signed selected-width offsets are extended to64, scaled by element bytes and added modulo2^64 to actual pointers. Masked-off input/output pointers impose no access bound; only resulting active addresses are checked against regions/permissions. The unmasked inverse load is checked once per program. No padded-i32/no-wrap or ArithmeticRefines prerequisite; safe wrapped-but-different accesses remain covered.
configuration.grid_domain: Host cdiv grid uses exact nonnegative integers; signed-int grid-x parsing requires gridM*gridN<2^31, otherwise genuine gridParse/gridLimit first rejection before entry hook, CPU-pointer extraction, launch and exit hook. This is a target launch prerequisite, not an address-safety inference.
configuration.returned_semantics: NativeResult specifies independent actual-address write plan, returned tensors, every final byte, and untouched-byte frame. Mathematical transpose additionally follows under optional ArithmeticRefines; it is not a premise of the main outcome theorem.
configuration.numerical_domain: All storage words; LlrintDefined partitions exact returned result versus semantic conversionUndefined observation. Defined iff decoded finite and nearest-even rounded integer is in [-2^63,2^63); no native trap or rollback claim and no domain waiver
